notes: Public / school building ('HaChinuch HaIvri' entrance sign). Dominant feature is a large corrugated grey barrel-VAULT roof spanning the front (roof.form 'barrel' -- factory currently renders only flat/gable/hip, so a barrel form is a factory extension; falls back to open until added). Green tubular-steel perimeter fence and pedestrian gate, terracotta-paver plaza with a low-poly tree island and curved entrance steps (steps/ramp not expressible). Colours estimated from ref.
